title: Extract the Greeting
prompt: Three print lines greet three people. Refactor: write greet(name, balance) that returns the greeting string, and use it for all three people. Keep the printed lines IDENTICAL (three lines).
boilerplate:
print("Welcome Minh, your balance is 120")
print("Welcome Lan, your balance is 90")
print("Welcome Bo, your balance is 0")

tests.name: same output, now factored
tests.code:
assert printed == ["Welcome Minh, your balance is 120", "Welcome Lan, your balance is 90", "Welcome Bo, your balance is 0"], f"got {printed}"
assert "def greet" in code, "define greet(name, balance)"
assert greet("Test", 5) == "Welcome Test, your balance is 5", "greet must RETURN the string, not print it"
tests.hint: The function returns f"Welcome {name}, your balance is {balance}"; the loop prints each.
